balanced diet = a way of eating that includes a healthy mix of different foods
junk food = unhealthy food that is high in fat, sugar or salt
fizzy drink = a sweet drink with bubbles of gas in it
sparkling water = water with bubbles of gas in it
still water = water without bubbles of gas
dairy = food made from milk, such as cheese or yoghurt
poultry = birds kept for meat or eggs, such as chicken or turkey
seafood = animals from the sea that people eat, such as fish and prawns
wholemeal = made from the whole grain, not just the white part
vegetarian = a person who does not eat meat; food with no meat
ingredients = the foods you need to cook a particular dish
recipe = a set of instructions for cooking a dish
starter = a small dish eaten at the beginning of a meal
main course = the largest part of a meal, usually with meat or a hot dish
dessert = sweet food eaten at the end of a meal
takeaway = a meal you buy and take home to eat
leftovers = food remaining after a meal, often eaten later
book a table = to reserve a place in a restaurant in advance
the bill = the piece of paper that shows how much you must pay
tip = extra money you leave for the waiter
